# Ayu PNG rendering fixtures

These are unchanged PNG files from `ayu-theme/vscode-ayu` 1.6.0, commit
`605c9c8504682854d77adc0b630742182a86676b`, under its original MIT license.
Source: https://github.com/ayu-theme/vscode-ayu/tree/605c9c8504682854d77adc0b630742182a86676b/icons

They verify that the SVG pixel paths in `../../../../extensions/ayu-icons/assets/icons` preserve the
upstream RGBA pixels when rendered over light and dark backgrounds.
